name: Polyethylene furanoate (PEF): MeOH pretreatment + Methanolysis end-of-life
notes:
Kim, T. et al. Life Cycle Greenhouse Gas Emissions, Water and Fossil-Fuel Consumption for Polyethylene Furanoate and its Co-Products from Lignocellulosic Biomass, ACS Sustainable Chemistry & Engineering, 2021, Publication in preparation. 
This process takes account for the amount of carbon uptaken in the PEF after end-of-life stage. 
Currently, it is assumed that there is no degradation of PEF in its end-of-life, and 100% of the carbon uptaken in 1 ton of PEF (i.e., 1754.646kgCO2/ton-PEF) is given. 
The users are welcome to change this uptake credit value based on a more accurate end-of-life analysis.
